name: @guardbee/mcp-agent-graph-auditor
description: MCP server that builds a reachability graph across multi-agent orchestration configs (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen/ag2) to find transitive excessive agency — an agent with no dangerous tool of its own that can still reach one through delegation or group membership
long_description: Scans Python source defining a multi-agent system (LangGraph's add_node/add_edge graph, CrewAI's Agent/Crew/allow_delegation, or AutoGen/ag2's GroupChat/code_execution_config/register_function) and builds a unified agent+tool reachability graph. Classifies tools by name into dangerous-capability categories (code execution, process execution, filesystem write, network, credentials access), then finds every path from an agent to a dangerous tool. A direct has_tool edge is a familiar single-agent excessive-agency finding; a path crossing at least one delegation or group-membership edge before reaching the tool is the novel finding this package exists for — an agent that was never directly given the dangerous capability, but can still reach it through another agent. No API key required — runs entirely locally, static analysis only.
